Hero.description: The secure, community-driven platform to report lost items and safely connect with finders. Zero cost, total peace of mind.

Features.smartMatchingDesc: No, FindBack is completely free to use for both reporting lost items and claiming found ones. We believe helping people shouldn't cost money.
Features.secureChatDesc: Our claim system requires the claimant to provide specific, non-public details about the item to prove it's theirs.
Features.communityDesc: Use our secure, anonymous messaging system to arrange a safe meetup or delivery without exposing phone numbers.
